offering_description.value: Manufactures sportswear and outerwear garments, mainly knit and woven activewear, for large international apparel brands and retailers. Production is done in its own factories in Jordan, with additional capacity in Vietnam and Bangladesh through other facilities, and delivered to customers worldwide.

primary_products.value: athletic apparel; outerwear; jackets; pants and shorts; knit tops

customer_segment.value: B2B: large global apparel brands and retailers, such as VF Corporation, Columbia, Hanesbrands and Skechers

revenue_model.value: product sales: garments made to order for brand and retail customers, priced per unit

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: buys fabric and trims and cuts and sews garments in own factories, selling to apparel brands and retailers

geography_served.value: global: Production in Jordan, Vietnam and Bangladesh, sales mainly to the US, plus Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: knit and woven activewear, outerwear and other casual garments

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sold directly to apparel brand and retailer customers under supply contracts and purchase orders

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Trade and tariff rules, the US-Jordan free trade agreement, labor and customs compliance, and environmental rules

notes: Facility and customer details come from memory and may be out of date.
